description: This Java class 'MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl' implements data access object methods for retrieving merchant configuration data, utilizing the Querydsl library for building JPQL queries. It extends a generic DAO implementation and provides methods to fetch configurations by key, by store, and by type, specifically for merchant configuration entities.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access for MerchantConfiguration entities, providing methods to retrieve configurations based on store, key, and type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific merchant configuration by key for a given merchant store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Fetches all merchant configurations associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by configuration type for a specific merchant store.
